title: Villa Olimpicos Rincon
description: This inspiring modern beach villa sits in the center of the world-famous surfing destination making it a perfect place to nourish your body, mind, and spirit on your well-deserved vacation.Villa Olimpicos will surely take your beach holiday to a whole new level!The spaceLiving is easy in this generously spacious home with lots of options. Uniquely located such that you can see the ocean from the private balcony. Easily pick up your morning coffee around the corner at Cafe 2 Go, walk down the street and eat oceanfront at Harbor Restaurant or take a 2-minute drive to the famous Rincon Plaza. Walk one block and you are at Balneario de Rincon, a quiet public beach popular for swimming, snorkeling and Paddle boarding. The villa encompasses two spacious bedrooms with plenty of room for study, sleep and relaxation. The bedrooms, complete with premium linens and smart speakers, ensure a cozy space where you can unwind after a long day in the sun.The living room, equipped with a queen size sofa bed and large flat screen TV, opens up to a spacious balcony overlooking the pool where you can dine al fresco, and enjoy morning coffee or an evening watching the ever changing colors of the sunset.The kitchen area features stainless steel appliances and the essential cooking utensils to cook a delicious meal. You have a choice to dine inside on the expandable dining table of 6 or on the balcony. Two full bathrooms, with complimentary tolieties, are furnished with premiere linens for your ultimate comfort. This villa can sleep 6 comfortably.Additional amenities include cable and WIFI. Air conditioning and 1 uncovered dedicated parking space for two cars are treasured extras. Everything necessary to fully experience this Caribbean hotspot.This ideal location is convenient to the beach and within a quick drive to the numerous surf breaks, including Maria's, Sandy's, Domes and Tres Palmas. The space is perfect for a couple or couples, friends or a small family to nest away and still have full access to everything Rincon offers.Create beautiful memories of your vacation interlude in this “just right” charming beach haven. Who knows – you may never want to leave!Guest accessGuests have access to the entire villa and shared pool and spa.Other things to noteNo smoking is allowed inside the villa - NO EXCEPTIONS!Pool rules located at the pool and Covid Guidelines are in place for everyone’s safety. title: Coconut Cabana - Rincon's Newest Treasure!
description: Welcome to our Coconut Cabana! Filled with light, crisp and clean features, for a perfect island stay. We are perched on the hillside overlooking magical Rincon. A 10 minute walk down to the square for fun, food and local markets, or a short drive to local beaches and island adventures! Our neighborhood is quiet and at night you'll hear the peepers and see a million stars to make a wish. This is our dream spot and we look forward to sharing it with you as you explore enchanted Puerto Rico!The spaceThe Cabana is perfect for 2 couples or a small family. The space has everything you need to stay a few days or a few weeks. You have a full kitchen, but who wants to cook on vacation! We have enjoyed eating at the local stands and restaurants where you check out amazing local foods and brews and find a frappe for dessert. We are located a few blocks up from the town square and as you can see from the picture, the parking area is small. When you arrive you'll tuck your car in front and do be careful pulling out.

description: Looking for the perfect location for your next getaway? Look no further!
